Name: Animal Crossing Dig Spots for Content Patcher
Author: m2pt5
Description:
Replaces the worms/twigs dig spots with the star-shaped crack from Animal Crossing.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], which itself requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].

Simply unzip the file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
